 Gujarat Sees a Dip in Temperatures as Cold Wave Intensifies; 9 Cities Record Below 20°C
 November 14, 2026 · 2 min read 
 Facebook 
 Twitter 
 WhatsApp 
 Gujarat is witnessing a noticeable change in weather conditions as temperatures continue to decline across several parts of the state. With the arrival of cooler weather, residents have started experiencing a chill, particularly during the early morning and night hours. According to the latest weather update, nine cities across Gujarat have recorded minimum temperatures below 20°C.
 According to the reported temperature figures, Vadodara emerged as the coldest city in the state, recording a minimum temperature of 16.5°C. Naliya followed with 17°C, while Ahmedabad recorded 18.4°C. Rajkot and Amreli registered 19.7°C, and Surat recorded 19.9°C. These figures indicate a noticeable drop in night-time temperatures across different regions of Gujarat.The change in weather is being attributed to the influence of north-easterly winds, which have brought cooler conditions to the state. People are experiencing pleasant weather during the morning and late-night hours, while daytime temperatures continue to remain relatively warm.
 According to the weather forecast, minimum temperatures in Ahmedabad are likely to remain between 17°C and 19°C over the next three days. The cold is expected to become more noticeable in the coming days, particularly during early mornings. Meanwhile, dense fog was also reported in parts of Kutch, including Bhuj and Madhapar, reducing visibility on roads and prompting motorists to drive cautiously.
